top_choice_rationale: Round 2 left B007 as a mature, single-part achievement on which all six agree for Drucker and Holst; the only open point is the third name. I keep Knudsen (P002) because her acylation-based albumin-binding design is a documented, original step that turned the physiology into once-daily and once-weekly drugs and into the outcome trials in diabetes, obesity, cardiovascular and renal disease, so a citation naming both the physiology and the long-acting agonists is true for all three names. Mojsov's priority for the active form cannot be verified from the supplied record and Habener is outside the credit, so P001 carries the greater attribution risk, although it is a coherent prize on a discovery-only principle and I rank it second by a narrow margin. No award (P000) is last because the science is beyond doubt and recognition carries almost no risk of reversal.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; disclosed postdoctoral period with Paul Greengard and co-authorship with committee colleague Thomas Perlmann, neither involving a credited name on B007
